highlights.title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
highlights.summary: Some of the most dramatic footage from the deadly flash flooding is hidden from public view in China.

highlights.title: Live Updates: Scale of Flood Disaster Grows as Nepal Doubles Estimate of Missing
highlights.summary: A spokeswoman for the Nepali disaster relief agency said the tally grew to 1,900 after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new flooding.

highlights.title: Nepal and China resume flood rescue as death toll nears 600
highlights.summary: Rescue operations have resumed after a brief pause, but experts caution of danger from a newly formed lake.

highlights.title: Número de mortos no Nepal sobe para 626 após avalanche de lama

highlights.title: La tragedia de Nepal alerta sobre una amenaza creciente: 15 millones de personas viven bajo la amenaza de los lagos glaciares
highlights.summary: El mapa global de riesgo de este tipo de eventos extremos muestra cómo el fenómeno se ha multiplicado por seis en un siglo, impulsado por el cambio climático

highlights.title: Islandia vota en referéndum si reabre las negociaciones de adhesión a la Unión Europea
highlights.summary: Los sondeos apuntan a un resultado muy ajustado en la consulta de este sábado, tras una campaña centrada en el coste de la vida y el control de los recursos pesqueros
